scope: SQLite execution of all web D1 migrations, synthetic Ed25519 seller key, synthetic AES-GCM code key, no external channel adapter
implementation: Migration 0052 adds channel-neutral issuer delivery records with hashed idempotency key, exact request digest, signed claim JSON, encrypted claim code and explicit prepared/delivered state.
Migration 0053 records code-encryption key IDs so prepared deliveries remain recoverable across key rotation while old keys stay in the operator keyring.
Same seller key and request recover the exact claim/code; changed request under one key fails closed; concurrent same-key calls converge on one persisted package.
AES-GCM AAD binds issuer, idempotency digest, request digest, claim digest and encryption key ID. Plaintext claim code is never stored in D1.

Delivery timeout preserves the prepared ciphertext and retries the same package with the same delivery key. Confirmed delivery clears ciphertext and nonce while retaining non-secret claim/audit fields.
Key rotation can recover old prepared rows only while their recorded key ID remains available; the seller operator must retain previous keys until no prepared rows reference them.

includes: same-request recovery, scope-order normalization and no plaintext code at rest
8 concurrent identical issuer requests converge to one record and one winning package
changed request and unavailable/wrong encryption keys fail closed
delivery timeout retains the encrypted package and callback retry receives byte-identical package/key
delivery acknowledgement clears secret ciphertext and is idempotent
key rotation recovers a prepared package with the previous key ID
